title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WPKoi WordPress…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPKoi Templates for Elementor WordPress themes up to version 3.7.5. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers.
